info.name: SIKAP Subscription API
info.description:
Complete API collection for SIKAP Subscription Backend.

**Setup:**
1. Set the `base_url` variable to your server (default: `http://localhost:8000`)
2. Call **Register** or **Login** — the test script auto-saves the token into the `token` variable
3. All protected requests use `{{token}}` automatically via the collection-level Bearer auth

**Roles:**
- Regular endpoints → any authenticated user
- `[ADMIN]` endpoints → user must have `is_admin = true`

request.description:
Register a new user. Automatically grants a 7-day free trial and generates a referral code.

**Auto-saved on success:** `token`, `user_id`, `referral_code`

`referral_code` is optional — include someone else's code to link the referral.

Login by `external_user_id` (preferred) or `email`. Returns a new Sanctum bearer token.

**Auto-saved on success:** `token`, `user_id`

Provide either `external_user_id` or `email` — not both required.
Revokes the current Bearer token. Other tokens (other devices) remain valid.
Returns the authenticated user's profile and their current subscription state.

item.name: Auth — External (Attendance Server)
item.description:
Integration with the attendance server. `exchange-token` and `validate-access` are **public**. `refresh-subscription` requires a Sanctum Bearer token.

**Typical Android flow:**
1. User logs in to attendance server → gets `attendance_token`
2. POST **Exchange Token** with just `{ attendance_token, device_name }` → receive Sanctum `token` + full access status
3. Save Sanctum `token` → use for all subsequent calls (`{{token}}`)
4. On every app launch: POST **Validate Access** for a quick yes/no check (cached 60 min)
5. If token is stale: POST **Refresh Subscription** to force re-sync

**⚠️ Never send the user's password to this backend — the attendance token is sufficient.**

request.description:
**Public.** Main entry point after Android user logs in to the attendance server.

**Required:** `attendance_token` (dari response login server presensi)
**Optional:**
- `device_name` — label untuk Sanctum token (default: `mobile-app`)
- `username` + `password` — kredensial server presensi; disimpan agar backend bisa **auto-refresh token** saat expired tanpa user harus login ulang

**What happens internally:**
1. Token validated → full profile fetched from attendance server
2. User found-or-created (auto 7-day trial for new users)
3. `attendance_profiles` row saved (token + credentials + jabatan, is_active, dll)
4. **Sanctum token issued** untuk API calls berikutnya
5. Access gate evaluated (`is_active` AND active subscription)

**Response `data`:**
- `token` → Sanctum Bearer token — **simpan ini untuk semua request selanjutnya**
- `user` → local user record
- `attendance_profile` → `{ is_active, jabatan, tipe, kode_unit_kerja, ... }`
- `subscription` → `{ status, isActive, remainingDays, ... }`
- `access` → `{ can_access: bool, reason: string|null }`

**Auto-saved on success:** `token`, `user_id`

**Public.** Mengambil `user` + `attendance_profile` + `subscription` + `access` hanya dengan `attendance_token`.

Endpoint ini **tidak** menerbitkan Sanctum token. Jika client butuh token untuk memanggil endpoint protected, gunakan **Exchange Token**.

Query param:
- `attendance_token`

**Public.** Lightweight gate check — answers "can this user open the app right now?"

`external_user_id` is a **string** (matches the attendance server's `id` field, e.g. `"8513"`).

Re-validation against the attendance server is skipped when the user was validated within the last **60 minutes** — safe to call on every app launch without hammering the attendance server. When re-validation does happen, the stored `attendance_profile` is also refreshed.

**Gate logic (both must be true):**
1. `attendance_profile.is_active = true` → employee is active on attendance server
2. Our subscription is active (trial or paid)

**Response `data`:**
```json
{
  "can_access": true,
  "reason": null,
  "revalidated": false
}
```
`revalidated: true` means the backend actually called the attendance server this time.

**Use this** when you only need a yes/no answer. Use **Exchange Token** when you need the full profile + Sanctum token.

**Protected** (requires Bearer `{{token}}`). No request body needed.

Forces a full re-sync of the authenticated user's attendance profile using the **stored** token in `attendance_profiles`. The cache for the stored token is bypassed so the attendance server is always hit.

**Use this when:**
- App resumes after a long background period
- User reports their access status looks stale
- An admin has changed the user's subscription manually

**Response 200 `data`:**
- `user` → updated user record
- `attendance_profile` → fresh `{ is_active, jabatan, tipe, ... }`
- `subscription` → latest subscription status
- `access` → `{ can_access: bool, reason: string|null }`

**Response 401** when the stored attendance token has expired — the user must re-login to the attendance server from the Android app and call **Exchange Token** again.

item.name: Voucher
item.description:
Voucher code system untuk mengaktifkan atau memperpanjang subscription.

**User endpoints** — `redeem` dan `history` (requires Bearer token)
**Admin endpoints** — bulk-generate, create, list, show detail + redemptions, toggle active (requires admin token)

**Redeem logic:**
- Jika user punya subscription aktif (paid) → **extend** `end_date` sebanyak `duration_days`
- Jika tidak ada subscription / masih trial → cancel trial, buat subscription baru
- Setiap kode voucher hanya bisa dipakai **satu kali total** — begitu dipakai oleh siapapun, kode langsung terkunci

**Marketplace model:** Admin generate kode dalam batch, setiap kode dijual ke satu pembeli di marketplace. Pembeli menggunakan kode sekali untuk mengaktifkan subscription mereka.

request.description:
Gunakan kode voucher untuk mengaktifkan atau memperpanjang subscription.

Kode bersifat case-insensitive (`abcd-1234-efgh` = `ABCD-1234-EFGH`).

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "message": "Voucher berhasil digunakan. Langganan Anda diperpanjang 30 hari.",
  "voucher": { "code": "ABCD-1234-EFGH", "duration_days": 30 },
  "redemption": { "id": 1, "redeemed_at": "2026-05-08T..." },
  "subscription": { "status": "active", "isActive": true, "remainingDays": 37, ... }
}
```

**Response 422** pada:
- Kode tidak ditemukan
- Voucher tidak aktif
- Voucher belum berlaku / sudah kadaluarsa
- Voucher sudah digunakan (oleh siapapun — kode bersifat single-use)
Paginated history voucher yang sudah di-redeem oleh user yang sedang login.

Generate banyak kode voucher sekaligus untuk dijual di marketplace. Setiap kode bersifat **single-use** — satu kode untuk satu pembeli.

- `quantity` — wajib; jumlah kode yang di-generate (min: 1, max: 1000)
- `duration_days` — wajib; berapa hari subscription per kode
- `plan_id` — `null` = pakai plan termurah saat redemption
- `valid_from` / `valid_until` — `null` = tidak ada batas waktu
- `notes` — catatan internal untuk semua kode dalam batch ini

**Response 201:**
```json
{
  "message": "10 voucher berhasil di-generate.",
  "data": {
    "quantity": 10,
    "duration_days": 30,
    "valid_until": "2026-12-31",
    "codes": [
      "ABCD-1234-EFGH",
      "WXYZ-5678-MNOP",
      ...
    ]
  }
}
```

Semua kode di-insert dalam satu batch — efisien untuk generate ratusan kode sekaligus.

Buat satu voucher baru (single-use).

- `code` — opsional; jika kosong/dihilangkan, sistem auto-generate format `XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`
- `duration_days` — wajib; berapa hari subscription yang diberikan
- `plan_id` — `null` = pakai plan termurah saat redemption
- `valid_from` / `valid_until` — `null` = tidak ada batas waktu
- `notes` — internal catatan admin, tidak ditampilkan ke user

Untuk membuat banyak kode sekaligus (marketplace batch), gunakan **Admin — Bulk Generate Vouchers**.

query.description: Filter: 1 = aktif saja, 0 = nonaktif saja, hilangkan untuk semua

**Auto-saved:** `referral_code`

Applies a referral code for the authenticated user. Can be called after registration if the code was not provided during sign-up.

Guards: cannot self-refer, cannot apply if already referred.

Minimum payout amount is set in referral settings (default IDR 50,000).

`payout_method` options: `bank_transfer`, `paypal`, `gopay`, `ovo`
Same as Request Payout but via PayPal.

Paginated payout request history for the authenticated user.

item.description: Admin dashboard for referral system management. Requires `is_admin = true`.

request.description: System-wide referral dashboard: total referrals, commissions, payouts, top referrers.
Paginated list of all commissions across all users. Filter by `status`: `pending`, `credited`, `paid_out`, `cancelled`.
Manually credits a pending commission to the referrer's balance. Used when `auto_credit_commission` is disabled.
Cancels a pending commission. A `reason` is required.

Approves a payout request. Marks commissions as `paid_out` and deducts from the user's pending balance.
Rejects a payout request. `notes` is required when `success = false`.
Returns all referral settings with their keys, values, descriptions, and types.

Bulk-updates referral settings. All fields are optional (`sometimes`).

- `commission_percentage`: 0–100
- `min_payout_amount`: minimum IDR amount for payout
- `payout_method`: `manual` or `auto`
- `referral_bonus`: one-time bonus for the referred user (0 = disabled)
